title: What is the most common illness that doctors identified among the patients
question:
What is the most common illness that doctors identified among the patients whose lab work was done between 1/1/1985, and 12/31/1995?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: the most common illness refers to MAX(COUNT(Diagnosis)); lab work between 1/1/1985 and 12/31/1995 refers to `Examination Date` between '1985-01-01' and '1995-12-31 '

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1.XCL_008
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.XCL_001 = T2.XCL_014
WHERE T2.XCL_015 BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '1995-12-31'
GROUP BY T1.XCL_008
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;
